verdict.rationale: First-party docs say users can connect MCP servers to Copilot Chat, build their own MCP server and integrate it, and use the GitHub MCP server to act on repositories, issues and pull requests from the IDE. Admins can also allow-list which MCP servers are permitted. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP tool use, evidence of MCP support beyond IDE Chat (e.g., the CLI or cloud agent), and detailed docs on how plugged-in tools are invoked.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect MCP servers to Copilot Chat to share context from other applications.
You can create a new MCP server to fulfill your specific needs, and then integrate it with Copilot Chat.
Learn how to use the GitHub Model Context Protocol (MCP) server to interact with repositories, issues, pull requests, and other GitHub features, directly from Copilot Chat in your IDE.
Control which MCP servers developers can access from their IDEs, and use allow lists to prevent unauthorized access.
